name: D. B. Corp Ltd
title: D. B. Corp Ltd - 533151 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Print ad revenue up ~6% in Q4 and 6.3% like-for-like in FY26, but circulation fell ~2% to ~39 lakh copies and yields were flat; newsprint expected up 6-8% in Q1.

triggers.label: Newsprint avg ~INR49,000/t, +6-8% in Q1
triggers.quote: this number will further go up maybe by 6% to 8% going forward in the quarter 1 itself

triggers.label: April double-digit ad growth
triggers.quote: in the month of April, we have seen a very good double-digit strong growth

triggers.label: Ad yield flat in Q4
triggers.quote: The yield has largely remained the same largely. The growth has come from the volumes.

guidance.quote: we believe that the maintaining of this number, this margin should be achievable

red_flags.label: Circulation down ~2% to 39 lakh despite spending
Dividend not declared; cash deployment unclear
red_flags.quote: Board is evaluating more tax -efficient manner to use the cash.

evasions.quote: We don't give the exact number sector -wise and all that because of the competitive reason.
Certainly, we'll be looking at thinking that what is the best tax -efficient manner to do with the cash.
